responsibility: This file lowers function calls from generic expanded form into RTL call sequences according to target calling conventions. It computes argument locations, promotions, by-reference passing, stack and register argument setup, sibling/tail-call viability, outgoing argument stack management, call expression flags, and return-value handling, producing the concrete RTL call insns and related temporaries that bridge tree/RTL expansion with target ABI hooks.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for RTL call lowering in the `calls` group: it computes calling-convention details and emits call sequences, while `gcc/calls.h` only declares the ABI/call-expansion interfaces and `function_arg_info` helpers.
